description: Interview preparation for experienced professionals and leaders using the TRX Search methodology.

capabilities: Interview preparation and mock interview coaching using a résumé and job description
defaultPrompt: I have an interview coming up. Help me prepare.
Use my résumé and this job description to identify what they are likely to probe.
Run a mock interview and coach me one question at a time.
interface.longDescription:
TRX Search Interview Prep Coach™ helps experienced professionals prepare for interviews with greater clarity, confidence, and evidence from their actual experience. Upload your résumé and job description to understand the likely hiring priorities, identify your strongest alignment and potential pressure points, develop relevant examples, anticipate likely interview questions, and practice your answers one question at a time.

The Coach helps you communicate your judgment, ownership, results, and transferable experience without scripting, exaggerating, or inventing accomplishments. It also helps you prepare thoughtful questions so you can evaluate the opportunity as carefully as the company is evaluating you.
interface.tagline: Prepare your examples. Communicate your value. Have a better conversation.

name: trx-interview-prep-coach
